integrity: The proof is self-contained. The focal preprint and the later closely related full text were inspected, and database/search comparisons were made against the exact statement and its stronger odd-integer form.
scientific_limitations: The exact step law is proved only for odd integers \(N\ge5\); even steps can lose primes through divisors \(p+1\) of \(N\). The finite checker through \(100000\) is corroborative and is not used as an infinite proof.
title: Odd step law for primes in floor-function sets
